d: Apple and cedarwood open crisp, with bamboo, jasmine and rose in the heart. Amber and musk soften the finish, giving a breezy, green-floral scent with a lemony brightness.
Jasmine sambac turns creamy and radiant here, resting on a woody cashmeran core and a soft amber glow that lingers close to the skin.
Pear and blackcurrant lead into iris, orange blossom and jasmine sambac, ending in a sweet blend of praline, vanilla and patchouli.
Coffee and white flowers are drawn together by a soft, sweet vanilla.
Sharp, bright bergamot and pepper give way to amberwood with a warm, mineral glow. Crisp, spicy and easy to wear.
A dark, truffled floral: black truffle and ylang ylang with orchid and plum, deepened by rum and patchouli.
Rich and sweet: tobacco leaf and ginger with spice, tonka and cocoa, plus a dried-fruit accord.
A dessert-like spiced gourmand: cinnamon, nutmeg and bergamot lead into dates, praline and tuberose, then a long vanilla, tonka, myrrh and benzoin base.
Jasmine and saffron open airy and golden, held together by cedarwood and an ambergris accord.
A fresh fruity opening of apple, bergamot and blackcurrant leads to rose, birch and jasmine, with a smoky-musky base of ambergris and patchouli.
Apple, juniper and sage sit under a sparkle of bergamot and ginger. Vetiver and frankincense hold the base, keeping the whole thing fresh, green and a little smoky.
Cardamom opens a heart of lavender and iris, resting on a sweet, warm vanilla. Aromatic, powdery and soft.
Sparkling lemon and blackcurrant open onto pineapple and jasmine, while birch and oakmoss give the base a smoky, earthy edge.
Clove and pink pepper crackle like embers, with chestnut and guaiac wood adding a smoky sweetness. Vanilla and cashmeran leave a soft, woody glow.

n: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely
d: Pink pepper and juniper open sharp, lavender, cinnamon and sage add herbal spice, and vanilla, tonka bean and chestnut make a sweet, nutty base.
Lavender is warm and herbal over a heart of tonka bean. Benzoin brings a sweet, resinous depth.
Almond and jasmine sambac meet tuberose, then drift into tonka bean and chocolate. Creamy, floral and sweet.
Mandarin, pink pepper and blackcurrant lead to tuberose, lily of the valley and caramel. Sandalwood, amber, vanilla and orchid keep it sweet and warm.
Anise, black pepper and bergamot lead to lavender and labdanum, finishing on vanilla, patchouli and vetiver.
Mint and mandarin start cool, then cinnamon and rose bring heat and sweetness. A base of leather and Amberketal makes it warm and spicy.
Peony, freesia and lychee open light and juicy, magnolia, lily of the valley and rose form the heart, and cedarwood, amber and honey close warm and sweet.
Pomegranate leads into lotus and orchid, resting on violet, amber, mahogany and musk.
Cognac and oak give a boozy opening, followed by cinnamon and a sweet, nutty base of tonka bean, sandalwood and praline.

n: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum

d: Mandarin and neroli brighten a creamy bloom of orange blossom and jasmine sambac, settling into a quiet base of musk and vanilla.
Neroli and pink pepper open lightly, then rum and sage bring a smooth, herbal warmth. Tobacco and vanilla finish sweet and low-lit.
A floral bouquet that opens with peony, moves to centifolia rose and settles on freesia and vanilla. Soft, sweet and ambery.
A dense blend of spice and lavender resting on woody depth. Herbal, warm and concentrated, with a fresh edge that lingers around the spice.
An apple-and-lavender blend: bergamot and cardamom up top, violet and geranium in the middle, patchouli, vanilla and praline below.
Bergamot lights the opening before creamy coconut and tonka beans take over, giving a sunny, sweet and relaxed trail.
Fresh and floral-woody: buchu, marigold, bergamot and blackcurrant, then cyclamen, jasmine and violet, over tonka, cedarwood, musks and vetiver.
A bright, spiced opening of apple, cinnamon, lavender and bergamot gives way to orange blossom and lily of the valley, before tonka bean, vanilla, amber and patchouli close sweet and warm.
A boozy cherry gourmand: black cherry and cherry syrup with bitter almond, rose, balsam and roasted tonka.
A woody, leathery men's fragrance that opens with bergamot, pomarose and sage, moves through vetiver and leather, and settles into patchouli and ambery woods.
Bergamot flickers over orange blossom, resting on soft, creamy musk. A white floral that feels clean, luminous and quietly sweet.
A soft gourmand: lavender, pear and bergamot open lightly, coconut, praline and vanilla orchid make a creamy heart, and a cashmere base keeps it plush.
Smooth woods and spice: cardamom and pink pepper open into patchouli, amber and oud, warmed by tonka bean.
Mint, lemon and a green watery accord feel cool and clean, followed by pink pepper, jasmine sambac and peony. Cedarwood, labdanum and brown sugar warm the close.
Pepper and saffron give a dry, spicy heat, deepened by the resinous warmth of labdanum.

n: The One for Men Eau de Parfum
d: Basil, coriander and grapefruit open aromatic, then cardamom, ginger and orange blossom warm the heart. Cedarwood, tobacco and amber make the base smooth, dry and softly spicy.
Bergamot, mandarin and pear brighten a heart of lavender, neroli and sambac jasmine. Iris, vanilla and sandalwood close it smoothly.
Blackcurrant and pink pepper add a little sparkle before rose and violet take over in a powdery heart. Musk and vanilla keep the finish soft and warm.
Ambrette, salt and sage create a breezy, mineral calm. Herbal and musky, with the feel of a cool coastal walk.
A coffee-led gourmand with a spiced opening of cinnamon, cardamom and ginger, a sweet praline and candied-fruit heart, and a vanilla, tonka and musk base.
Grapefruit, sea notes and mandarin start bright and salty. Bay and jasmine form the heart, and guaiac wood, oakmoss, patchouli and ambergris leave a mossy, earthy base.
Green mango and lotus blossom bring a juicy, watery brightness, softened by smoky incense and sycamore wood.
Passion flower gives a lightly floral start before a warm vanilla heart and an earthy base of vetiver.
Lime and lemon give a tart, bright opening, with gardenia and apple adding a fruity floral heart. Musk and cedarwood leave the finish clean and lightly woody.
Tangerine, bergamot and blackcurrant leaves sparkle over lily of the valley, rose and apricot, easing into a vanilla, tonka and musk base with cedar.
A minimalist, skin-close scent built on a single woody-amber molecule, cetalox, for a clean musky effect.
Deep and glowing, an amber built from cistus labdanum, benzoin and vanilla, resinous and sweet.
Spicy and herbal at the heart: Sichuan pepper, anise, nutmeg and lavender, under a bright bergamot lift. Ambroxan and vanilla bring a smooth, warm finish.
Lychee and freesia sparkle over magnolia, jasmine and a little ginger and pepper, resting on amber and musk.
Green mandarin, ginger lily and jasmine over a salty vanilla, with cashmere wood and ambergris giving a smooth, skin-warm base.
Vanilla and lavender meet an unexpected salty note of caviar in the heart. It is sweet and creamy, with a briny edge that keeps the warmth from turning heavy.
A fresh citrus-woody scent built on citrus and blackcurrant with cold spices, aquatic jasmine and patchouli leaves, drying down to leather, oakmoss and vanilla.
A dark, warm amber for men: black pepper, pineapple and tobacco on top, patchouli, coffee and iris in the middle, and vanilla, benzoin and labdanum below.
Doubled bergamot meets orange blossom in a clean, floral heart, resting on wood, patchouli and a soft Ambrofix glow. Fresh and sunlit.
A rosy, fruity-floral built on lychee and rhubarb over damascena rose, resting on soft musks, cashmeran and vetiver.
Wild berries add a tart, juicy start before violet and jasmine form a soft, powdery floral heart. Sandalwood warms the base, making a light, sweet and woody scent.

n: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Parfum

d: Bergamot, juicy pear and pink peppercorn open onto rose and jasmine, ending in white musk, vanilla, patchouli and cedarwood.
Australian sandalwood and cedarwood are spiced with cardamom and powdered by iris and violet, with papyrus giving a dry edge.
Mandarin, saffron and cardamom open spiced and glowing. Orange blossom and jasmine soften the heart, while vanilla, sandalwood and amber give a rich, creamy base.
Mandarin, thyme and saffron open bright and herbal, lily forms a fresh floral heart, and oakwood leaves a dry, woody close.
A spicy-floral scent with bergamot, pink berries, elemi and nutmeg on top, rose, flax flower and magnolia in the heart, and a dry vetiver and ambery base.
A heavy, spicy tobacco scent: saffron, cinnamon, incense, nutmeg, peach, apple and oud open, with patchouli and jasmine beneath tobacco, amber, vetiver, vanilla and musk.
Neroli opens gently before rose and honeysuckle, leaving a sweet, warm trail of marshmallow and labdanum. Soft, creamy and floral.
Mandarin and red berries lead to gardenia, honeysuckle and jasmine. Caramel, amber and vanilla over sandalwood and praline make the finish sweet and creamy.
Cannabis and green notes lead into resin, woody notes and tobacco, and the scent ends with frankincense and agar wood.
Black rose, vanilla and orchid sit in a dark, sweet heart, with lychee and praline over incense and papyrus.
Mandarin lightens a smoky centre of osmanthus and leather. Akigalawood and immortelle give the base a dry, resinous edge.
Jasmine glows against a sweet, nutty heart of chestnut and vanilla, drying to a smooth sandalwood base.
Coconut and fig give this a milky, fruity start, then sandalwood slowly lifts it into warm, sweet woods. Easy, creamy and lightly tropical.
Lemon sparkles over a creamy heart of orange blossom, resting on vanilla. A simple, sweet trio that feels bright and soft together.
Soft, sweet and fruity-floral: orchid, heliotrope and tangerine up top, a creamy gourmand and tropical fruit heart, then vanilla, musk and sandalwood.
Bergamot, fig, mandarin and pear make a juicy citrus opening. Lily, jasmine and cardamom flow into sandalwood, cedarwood and musk.
Sweet and warm, with bergamot adding a cool flash up front. Coconut turns the middle creamy, and tonka bean leaves a soft, rounded base.
Sea notes and cypress give a deep, salty, green freshness, resting on soft musk. Cool and clean, like wind off dark water.
A citrus-chypre scent: bergamot, pineapple and grapefruit give a juicy opening, jasmine, patchouli and cedarwood form the heart, and clearwood, oakmoss and dry timberwood anchor it.
Vanilla orchid and brown sugar lead a deep, sweet blend with tonka absolute, amber woods and a soft layer of musk.
A lavish rose enriched with blackcurrant, raspberry and clove, then deepened by patchouli and sandalwood.

n: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense

d: Coriander flickers at the start, then a heavy tuberose heart sinks into a warm, resinous trail of opoponax.
Black cherry and black rose carry a sweet, shadowy glow with almonds, while smoked tea, licorice, patchouli and tonka linger at the base.
Clean citrus from mandarin and bergamot meets a herbal edge of tarragon, keeping the mood cool and composed.
Sugared red berries and mandarin lead to rose, chocolate and a touch of spice, melting into amber, tonka bean and soft musk.
Lavender and orange blossom open into jasmine sambac and orchid, then tonka bean, vanilla and ambergris with a dry vetiver edge. Creamy, floral and warm.
Peony and rose gather in a fresh, airy bouquet, lifted by bergamot and finished with clean, soft musk. Gentle, springlike and uncomplicated.
Woody and aromatic: bergamot, juniper, lemon and pepper, then incense, orris and pine needle over amber, sandalwood and vanilla.
Fig, hazelnut and dried fruits sweeten the opening, then wood and spices add a warm, slightly dry depth.
Apple, lemon and bergamot with a pinch of cinnamon; orange blossom, cardamom and plum follow, finishing on patchouli, grey amber, driftwood and musk.

n: Light Blue Eau Intense Pour Homme

d: Raspberry and blackcurrant brighten a rose and jasmine heart, which settles into soft vanilla and musk. Fruity, floral and sweet.
Bergamot, blue ginger and pink pepper open into blackcurrant, Turkish rose and cardamom. A vanilla-led base of benzoin, ambergris, patchouli and sandalwood makes it warm, spicy and creamy.
A gentle fruit and flower composition: plum, freesia and a mossy, earthy base of oakmoss.

n: Gentleman Eau de Parfum Reserve Privée

d: A smooth tobacco gourmand: cinnamon and pepper meet tobacco leaf, incense and osmanthus, softened by vanilla, musks and cedarwood.
Cyclamen, mandarin and almond open sweetly, leading into amaryllis, jasmine and peony. Amber, musk and vanilla close it in a warm, creamy glow.
Raw leather and suede brightened by saffron, raspberry and thyme, with incense, night-blooming jasmine and amberwood.
A sweet, fruity scent: passion fruit, peach, raspberry, blackcurrant and pear over lily of the valley, resting on heliotrope, sandalwood, vanilla, patchouli and musk.
Soft and musky: ambrette and naseberry open to magnolia, sandalwood and violet, finishing on cedarwood, musks and vetiver.
An elegant, herbal-floral classic: rosemary and petitgrain open to neroli, iris and jasmine, resting on vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood.
Juicy strawberry and pear lead into peony and orange blossom, then dry down to soft musk, patchouli and vanilla. Fruity, floral and creamy.
Iris sits at the centre, powdery and cool, wrapped in warm amber and patchouli with a dry vetiver edge. Earthy and softly smooth.
Rose and coffee form the heart of this warm gourmand, framed by a floral opening. Amber, vanilla and white musk give it a creamy, roasted-sweet base.
A sensual, floral-free amber: bergamot, mandarin and lavender at the start, then a warm, musky heart of amber and vanilla that rests on sandalwood.
Freesia and pepper introduce a powdery floral heart of jasmine and heliotrope, finishing in dry cedarwood and soft suede.
Violet and two kinds of rose open a velvety floral that settles on natural oud, benzoin, vanilla and amber.
A warm, boozy spice blend of cinnamon, rum, tobacco and saffron on sandalwood, with hedione adding a smooth, airy touch.

n: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely
d: Rum opens boozy and warm, lavender gives a herbal heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.
Rose and jasmine take a powdery turn over a soft musk heart, with vetiver and cedar wood keeping the base dry and smooth.
Leathery and nutty-sweet: bitter almond, tonka and orris with cashmeran, leather and a herbal clary sage edge.
Honey and gardenia lend a rich, sweet floral tone, brightened by blood orange and grounded by an earthy patchouli.
Ripe pear leads to a delicate freesia heart, grounded by patchouli. Light, juicy and quietly earthy.

n: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Coral Fantasy

d: Bitter orange gives a zesty edge to a bright rose, with tonka bean adding a sweet, soft warmth underneath. Playful and fresh.
A clean, soft floral: aldehydes and rose open to peony and violet, with musks and sandalwood underneath.
Citrus, lavender and herbs form a bright coastal opening. Orange blossom, jasmine and neroli follow, ending in soft amber and ambrette. Creamy, floral and fresh.
A confectionery gourmand built on caramel, milk and sugar, with honey and white flowers in the heart and a creamy vanilla, praline and musk base.
Orange blossom opens bright over jasmine and patchouli. Cedarwood and honey give a sweet, earthy warmth.
A dessert-like blend where bitter orange gives way to cacao and vanilla, finishing on coffee bean and tonka. Sweet, roasted and rich, with a gourmand warmth throughout.
Bergamot and lemon open sunny, with ylang-ylang and coconut giving a warm floral heart. A base of musk, cedarwood and benzoin keeps it soft and skin-like.
Bergamot freshens a green pear heart, resting on vanilla. Fruity and sweet, with a bright citrus lift.
Ambroxan and ambrette seeds create a skin-like glow, with jasmine and moss adding an earthy, floral edge.
A creamy, sun-warmed floral: bergamot and cardamom with pistachio, ylang ylang and benzoin, rounded by a coconut-like accord.
A warm amber gourmand. Citrus, saffron and ginger open, followed by rose, jasmine and amber, with sandalwood, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk as the base.

n: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Fico di Amalfi

d: Bergamot, mandarin and honey open the door to a thick floral heart of jasmine, rose, orchid and magnolia. Suede, myrrh and sandalwood finish plush and resinous.
Rose, mandarin and honeysuckle open lightly, with jasmine, peony and gardenia opening into a creamy floral heart. Patchouli, musk and sandalwood give it a soft, warm finish.
Clementine and orange blossom meet basil and chamomile, with green tea, ivy and peony, while sandalwood and amber settle at the end.
Coconut and bergamot open bright and creamy, jasmine blooms in the heart, and benzoin and vanilla leave a sweet, warm finish.
Saffron and bergamot lead into rose and oud, settling on amber, tonka bean, leather and brown sugar. A sweet, smoky and warm oriental built on a soft musk base.
Dark and resinous: saffron and black truffle over vanilla, patchouli and oud, with a floral touch of crocus.
Bergamot, lime and mandarin sparkle over hibiscus, ylang-ylang and jasmine. A creamy floral heart settles into soft musk and light wood.
Lemon, mandarin, mint and apple open cool and green. Geranium and clary sage add a herbal heart, and cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla make a woody, sweet base.
A fresh, clean men's scent: grapefruit, bergamot and pink pepper over watery lavender and cardamom, resting on white musk, pale woods, cashmere and oakmoss.
Grapefruit, orange blossom and sage open sharp, then nutmeg, iris and pimento add a powdery spice. Vetiver, amber and oakmoss ground it in earthy warmth.
Bergamot and citron open over a briny blend of seaweed, calone and hedione, drying to a mineral base of ambroxan, cedar and musk.
A creamy floral built on orange blossom, rose, osmanthus and tuberose, with daffodil giving the base a soft, green finish.
Pineapple, bergamot and juniper open bright, then lavender, mint and rosemary add an herbal freshness. Violet and orange blossom lead to a warm base of amber, sandalwood and tonka bean.

n: Bade'e Al Oud Oud for Glory

d: A dark, spiced oud: agarwood oil and oud with lavender, saffron, nutmeg and patchouli, softened by musk.
Pear, frankincense and hazelnut lead into saffron, rose and osmanthus. Labdanum, sandalwood, ambergris and vanilla make a warm, sweet and woody close.

n: Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Toilette
d: Lavender and cypress keep it cool and green, with liquorice adding a faint, sweet edge.
Bright bergamot and mandarin warm into amber and woody notes, ending on musk and patchouli with a faint spiced edge.
A bright floral: bergamot, lychee and peach lead into orange blossom and jasmine, with a base of musk, pale wood and moss.
Mandarin brings a bright citrus lift to a green, herbal heart of santolina, finishing on clary sage.
Apple, bergamot and ginger freshen lavender, sage and juniper. Tonka bean, cedarwood and vetiver leave a herbal, warm finish.
Raspberry and rose give a juicy floral sweetness, anchored by akigalawood. Fruity, rosy and gently woody.
Elemi and bitter orange give a bright, slightly salty start, and benzoin brings a warm, resinous sweetness.
Turkish rose and incense carry a resinous heart, brightened by bergamot, pear and lychee. Oud, amber and vanilla sweeten and deepen the base.
Green and bright with bergamot and angelica, then patchouli, amber, coal and musk deepen the base.
Redcurrant and lychee give a tart, juicy opening, with rose in the middle and a base of vetiver and vanilla.
Mandarin and cinnamon spark a spiced, resinous heart of cedarwood, cumin and incense, drying down to cypress and tobacco.
Peach and blood orange are spiked with cardamom, then rum, cognac and sambac jasmine move into a thick base of sandalwood, benzoin, vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli.
A clean, soft musk scent that pairs bergamot, mandarin and blackcurrant with white magnolia, then settles on white sandalwood and two kinds of musk.
Juicy pear sits on creamy white gardenia, with brown sugar adding a sweet, soft glow.
Chamomile opens herbal and gentle, with jasmine in the middle and a woody, musky base of sandalwood, cedar wood and vanilla.
Pineapple and saffron start bright with a fruity edge, and fir balsam gives the heart a green, resinous lift. Amber, cedarwood and oud close warm.
Sparkling bergamot and blackcurrant lead to jasmine sambac and lily-of-the-valley, and cedar, sandalwood, vanilla and tonka bean make the finish.
Clary sage adds a green, herbal start, caramel brings a gourmand sweetness, and vetiver holds it with an earthy dryness.
Grapefruit, sea notes and plum open fresh and juicy. Jasmine, cashmere wood, hazelnut and honey add sweet warmth, and patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss ground the end.
Raspberry, blackberry and blackcurrant make a dark fruit opening, with ylang-ylang, peony and rose. Wood, musk and vanilla finish sweet.
Raspberry, grapefruit and pear sparkle first, then violet, rose and apple blossom, resting on musk, cedarwood and a hint of plum.
Mandarin, peony and orchid brighten a creamy heart of vanilla, magnolia and ylang-ylang, softened by musk, amber and benzoin.
Blackcurrant and bergamot sparkle over rose and jasmine. Cedarwood and patchouli ground this fruity floral in a woody base.
Citron and orange blossom shine above a smooth base of amber wood.
Rose and iris open soft, with pepper and patchouli in the heart. Cashmere wood leaves a powdery, earthy finish.
Bergamot, mandarin and crisp apple stay bright over a smooth, ambery base of cedarwood. Fresh and sunlit, with a gentle warmth underneath.
Blackberry stays ripe and tart against green bay leaves, with cedarwood adding a dry, woody edge.
Almond and bergamot lead to ylang-ylang and peony, with vanilla and tonka bean making the finish sweet and warm.
Fig and bay leaves add a green, fruity thread to black tea and bergamot, with cedarwood, vetiver and musk beneath.
Juniper berries and nutmeg open dry and spicy, then coriander turns to a warm base of vanilla, musk and ambery woods.
Bergamot and rosemary give a clean, herbal brightness over a dry woody backbone. Fresh and citrusy with some depth.
Bergamot, sea notes and cardamom feel airy and fresh, with iris and basil verbena in the middle and earthy vetiver and patchouli below.
Gardenia and Bulgarian rose rest on a skin-like musk, with vetiver and cedar adding a quiet, woody line.
Mandarin and bergamot open fresh, cardamom and pepper add spice, and sandalwood with vanilla keeps the finish warm and soft.
Italian plum and saffron glow against Bulgarian rose, jasmine sambac and orris. Vetiver, papyrus wood and liquid amber give a smooth, warm base.
Melon and bergamot freshen a heavy, creamy heart of tuberose and jasmine, finished with a soft layer of musk.
A pinch of salt opens, then vanilla fills the heart, smooth and a little sweet. Musk keeps it close and clean, so the warmth feels comforting rather than heavy.
Bergamot and clary sage feel fresh and herbal, while iris, tonka bean and cedarwood add a powdery, smooth finish.
Honey, cinnamon and osmanthus open sweet and spiced. Amber, labdanum and benzoin deepen it, with vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli in a resinous base.
Spicy ginger brightens a creamy tuberose heart, while sandalwood gives the whole a smooth, woody finish.
Lavender and lemon feel crisp and herbal, melting into a vanilla base. Fresh with a sweet undertow.
Pear and raspberry open juicy and light, then lily of the valley, rose and orchid make a soft floral heart. Musk, woody notes and marshmallow leave a sweet, airy finish.
Lemon brightens the opening, then rose and Turkish delight make a sweet, floral heart. Cedarwood, vanilla and musk keep the base soft and warm.
A soft pear and ambrette start moves into rose and iris, powdery and fruity, set on clean cedarwood and white woods.
A tea-centred fresh scent. Bergamot, orange, litsea and mandarin open, oolong tea and nutmeg form the heart, and musk with fig finishes it softly.
Leather, cypress and patchouli sit over vetiver and dry woods. Earthy and green, with a smoky depth that feels dark and textured.
A rich, resinous scent with a fruity, spicy start of orange, blackberry and coriander, a honeyed heart with clove and rose, and a deep base of oud, myrrh, moss and ambergris.
Nutmeg and pepper add dryness to an opening of orange, bergamot and lemon, and vetiver, tobacco and tonka bean make the base.
Bergamot and violet brighten a powdery heart of coffee and iris, over a sweet, warm base of patchouli and vanilla.
Lily, peony, freesia and white lilac open as a soft bouquet, around jasmine and Bulgarian rose, with patchouli and white musk below.
Soft and almondy: anise, bergamot and almond open to cypress, violet leaves and orange blossom, drying down to vanilla, sandalwood and ambrox.
Cedarwood wrapped in spice and sweetness: honey, cinnamon, clove and cardamom, with plum, peach and violet in the heart. Sandalwood, benzoin, vanilla and musk keep it warm, dense and lingering.
A green, airy floral: cyclamen, freesia and rhubarb around a tulip heart, with blonde woods and vetiver below.
Lavandin, cardamom and pepper open aromatic and spiced. Incense and patchouli bring an earthy, smoky heart, and vanilla and tonka bean end sweet and warm.
A smoky, gourmand scent: cedarwood opens it, honey sits in the middle, and incense and vanilla form a dark, sweet base.
Rose and geranium open bold and floral, with palmarosa giving a green, bright edge. Patchouli, honey and oakmoss darken the base, sweet and earthy in equal measure.
A fruity-floral sweet scent: blackberry, bergamot and pear at the top, white flowers in the heart, then cassis, marshmallow, soft woods and vanilla below.

n: Mercedes Benz Club Black Eau de Toilette

d: A luminous white-floral musk: bergamot, mandarin and white peach, then orange blossom, finishing on musks, vanilla and vetiver.
Crisp apple and soft peony sit over a suede base. Fruity and floral, with a faint, smooth, soft-edged finish.
Star anise and blackcurrant bud give a tart, spicy beginning, followed by rose and magnolia, and a soft base of patchouli and vanilla.
Coffee and milk sit in the heart alongside lavender and tonka bean, giving a creamy, slightly herbal sweetness. Vanilla, cedarwood and vetiver close it warmly.
A cool, minty-aromatic fragrance: bergamot, spearmint and orange, then geranium, lavandin and pine, resting on sandalwood and musks.
Juniper and coriander give a crisp, aromatic start, while nutmeg and a soft vanilla musk bring a rounded, woody warmth.
Fresh and aromatic: bergamot, mandarin and pink peppercorn lead to lavender, iris and cardamom over fir balsam, tonka and white musks.
Mandarin gives a juicy, sunlit opening before sweet tonka bean and creamy sandalwood. Warm and rounded, with citrus keeping it fresh.
Bergamot, rhubarb and a fruity accord open onto rose and tuberose, drying down to patchouli and sandalwood.
A sweet gourmand fragrance: mandarin at the top, orange blossom in the middle and a soft caramel base. Fruity and creamy, with a candy-like character.
Ginger and bergamot give a sharp, bright start. Pine and fir balsam add a green, resinous chill before amber and patchouli warm the base.
A fruity-floral scent opening with magnolia, green apple and mandarin, flowing into white currant, peony and jasmine, over sandalwood, musk and amber woods.
Roasted pistachio and pear give a sweet, nutty start, with orange blossom and bitter almond leading to patchouli and tonka beans.
A fresh, airy musk with juicy pear, ginger and citrus on top, orange blossom in the heart, and a clean, woody-musky base.
Bamboo, bergamot and mandarin feel airy, over elemi, nutmeg and ginger. Amber and sandalwood make a warm, spiced finish.
Lily is the whole story here, from fresh citrus and green notes to soft, creamy petals.
A warm gourmand: green apple and saffron open onto tonka, rose and osmanthus, settling into vanilla, patchouli and a resinous opopanax finish.
Linden blossom, jasmine sambac and broom open soft and floral, then heliotrope, orange blossom and vetiver add a green, powdery heart. Ambrofix and Georgywood leave a smooth, woody finish.
Grapefruit brings a sharp citrus lift, then incense and vanilla follow in a warm, resinous and slightly sweet drydown.
Ambrette, jasmine and cedarwood, kept simple. A soft musky floral over clean, creamy wood that stays close and quiet.
Rose, geranium and saffron open floral and spiced, then cumin, nutmeg and violet add a powdery warmth. Amber, oud, vanilla and patchouli close deep.

n: Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum

d: Bergamot and pink pepper give a bright, peppery start, then musk and tuberose bloom together. Vanilla, patchouli and suede make the base warm, smooth and softly dark.
Citrus and a touch of nutmeg and pepper open onto powdery iris, rose and mimosa, then warm into honeyed sandalwood and musk.
Strawberry and bergamot open fruity. Jasmine and patchouli add a floral, earthy heart, and cedarwood with vanilla leaves a sweet, woody finish.
A warm, spiced leather: cardamom, geranium and pink pepper open it, rose, patchouli and cinnamon follow, and a dark base of leather, oud and amber lingers.
A juicy pear accord over a soft cetalox heart and musks, giving a clean, fruity skin scent.
Orange blossom and neroli float over a creamy heart of jasmine, rose and tuberose, resting on sandalwood, amber, vanilla and a powdery iris trace.
Melon and pineapple glow over a sweet gourmand accord, with amber, vanilla and soft musk rounding out the warmth.
Ylang-ylang and vanilla open sweet and floral, popcorn and ambrette add a toasty, musky heart, and vanilla returns with sandalwood for a warm, soft base.
Cedar and galbanum make a green, woody heart, freshened by lemon and bergamot and resting on sandalwood, oud and musk.
Plum and cinnamon open to leather and violet, over birch wood, patchouli and vanilla, like old paper and shelves.
Passion fruit and bergamot sparkle over gardenia and a boozy hint of rum, leaving benzoin and musk to warm the base.
A dewy spring floral: a green, slightly spicy bluebell accord, a soft milky-peach persimmon in the heart, and a clean white musk base.
A single-minded rose scent: lemon and rose petals at the top, rose in the middle, then amber and white musk for a soft, clean and slightly sweet finish.

Caviar, lime and mint open cool and salty, vodka and ginger add a spiced heart, and amber, musk and kingwood leave a warm, smooth finish.
Cedar wood and raspberry lead into a thick, earthy base of birch, moss, patchouli, vetiver, benzoin and vanilla.
Wild berries and lily of the valley open beside gardenia, then vanilla and honeysuckle appear. Caramel, praline and sandalwood close it softly.
Grapefruit, lemon and sea notes open crisp, with gardenia and green leaves in the heart. Musk and woody notes leave it airy and light.
Pink berry and bergamot lift a heart of lily, jasmine and ylang ylang. Meringue, patchouli and musk make the base airy and sweet.
Neroli and orange blossom give a creamy, softly sweet white floral that stays gentle. Patchouli grounds the base with a faint earthiness, adding depth to the soft petals.
An aromatic floral with bergamot and lavender up front, rose and patchouli in the middle, and a clean, skin-like ambroxan base.
Pink pepper, bergamot and frankincense open lightly spiced. Rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, then vanilla, benzoin, rum and cedarwood warm the base.
A creamy white floral. Tuberose, mandarin and peach lead to white jasmine, gardenia and orris, ending on vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver for a soft, smooth and powdery base.
Bergamot and geranium lift a smooth amberwood base. Sunlit and fresh, with a floral thread and quiet warmth.
Goji berry and bergamot brighten hibiscus and water lily. Pomegranate and cedarwood add a light fruitiness and a clean, woody finish.
A rich oriental built on saffron, cardamom, cinnamon and rose, opening with grapefruit and bergamot. Leather, oud, amber and vanilla give a deep, resinous, smoky base.
Coffee and amaretto lead into a dessert-like heart of ice cream and speculoos, resting on vanilla, brown sugar and ambergris. Sweet, warm and amber-toned.
Grapefruit and mango give a fruity, sunlit start, supported by the roasted sweetness of tonka beans.
Pear's soft juiciness meets a smooth vanilla and tonka bean for a sweet, warm and simple trio.

Papaya blossom and neroli lead to a heart of daffodil and water lily, with musk and cashmere giving a smooth finish.

Sparkling bergamot, mandarin and pepper give way to violet and jasmine, then a creamy, woody base of sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla.

La Nuit de L'Homme Bleu Électrique

Aromatic and dark: bergamot and pink pepper give way to saffron, praline and lavender, ending in oud, patchouli, vetiver and leather.

Beau De Jour Eau de Parfum

Saffron and juniper with pomelo, a violet-and-leather heart, and a base of blonde woods, raspberry and vetiver.

n: Chance Eau Tendre Eau de Parfum
